name: useSession
description: Headless React World ID session hook creating a client, polling every three seconds until a terminal state, exposing URI/result/errors and clearing its timer on cleanup.

metadata.semantic_review: Verified from pinned source; runtime not tested
metadata.overlap: World ID client integration, not the biometric recognition system or a standalone authentication server. Session confirmation/client UI success does not establish application authorization; verify proofs and bind actions/signals on a trusted backend.
metadata.deployment_warning: Treat connector URIs and proof results as sensitive. Backend verification, action/signal binding and replay/nullifier policy belong to the integrating application.
